timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹119.04 Cr, net profit ₹0.41 Cr.
Synergy Green guided for 33% revenue growth and 300 bps margin expansion in FY27 following the completion of its 45,000 TPA foundry expansion.
Synergy Green hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call on May 19, 2026, guiding for ~33% revenue growth and >300 bps margin expansion in FY27.
Synergy Green Industries Limited’s promoters, including **Sachin R. Shirgaokar**, confirmed no encumbrances on their shares as of March 31, 2026, with **0** shares pledged.
Conference call with analysts scheduled on November 03, 2026 at 4.00 p.m.
